---
title: "Runtime and Ratings"
---

@fig-runtime-rating shows relationship between movie runtime in minutes and the IMDB rating. 

```{python}
#| label: fig-runtime-rating
#| fig-cap: "Movie runtime in minutes versus IMDB rating. This association is more nuanced and random-looking."
#| echo: true

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"],films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDB Rating")
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| echo: true

films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")[["imdb_rating"]].mean().round(2) # rounding 2 digits, group by decade

```
